name: savoir-properties
description: Search Savoir Properties' Dubai listings and off-plan projects.

interface.longDescription:
Search the live property portfolio of Savoir Properties, a Dubai real-estate brokerage, directly in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- Find apartments, villas, townhouses, penthouses and offices for sale or rent across Dubai communities such as Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Downtown Dubai, JBR and JVC.
- Filter by area, purpose (buy or rent), property type, number of bedrooms (including studios), bathrooms, price range in AED, and ready or off-plan status.
- Open a listing to see its photos, price, size, amenities, reference and permit number, the listing agent's public contact details and similar properties.
- Explore new off-plan developer projects by developer, handover period or area, including starting prices and payment plans where the developer has published them.
- Get Savoir's WhatsApp, phone, email and website links, including a WhatsApp message pre-filled with the listing you are looking at.

All information comes from Savoir's own listings system and is shown as published. Prices and availability must be confirmed with a Savoir consultant. This app does not book viewings, take payments or collect your personal details; to arrange a viewing, contact Savoir using the links provided.

defaultPrompt: Show me 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Marina
Find studios for rent in JVC, cheapest first
Which Emaar off-plan projects hand over in 2029?

positive.description: Area + purpose + bedroom search returns matching listings with photos, AED prices and website links.
positive.prompt: Find 2-bedroom apartments for sale in Dubai Marina.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_properties with areas [Dubai Marina], purpose buy, bedrooms 2, property_type apartment. Shows listing cards (photo, AED price, 2 bedrooms, Dubai Marina location, Website/WhatsApp/Details buttons) and a text summary with savoirproperties.com links. No invented listings.

positive.prompt: Show me studios for rent, cheapest first.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_properties with bedrooms studio, purpose rent, sort price_low_to_high. Every result is a studio for rent, prices ascending.

positive.description: Follow-up opens full details of a listing from the previous results.
positive.prompt: Tell me more about the first one and show me the photos.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_property_details with the slug of the first result. Shows a photo gallery, price, size in sq ft, amenities, reference and permit number, the listing agent's public contact and the website link; similar listings may follow.

positive.description: Off-plan search by developer and handover year, then payment plan.
positive.prompt: Which Emaar off-plan projects hand over in 2029, and what is the payment plan for the first one?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls search_offplan_projects with developers [Emaar] and handover 2029, then get_offplan_project_details for a returned slug. Reports the payment-plan split only as published (e.g. down payment / during construction / on handover).

positive.description: Contact options for a specific listing.
positive.prompt: How can I contact Savoir on WhatsApp about this property?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_contact_options with the listing's slug. Returns a wa.me WhatsApp link pre-filled with the listing URL, the agent's public contact if available, and Savoir's phone, email and contact page. Does not claim a message was sent.

negative.description: Location with no Savoir listings: the app must say there are no results and must not invent listings.
negative.prompt: Find villas for sale on the Moon.

negative.description: Booking request: the app cannot book viewings; the assistant should explain this and offer contact options instead of claiming a booking.
